recentAuth.title: Confirm it's you

descriptions.password: For your security, enter your password to continue.
descriptions.twoFactor: For your security, enter your password and a code from your authenticator app to continue.
descriptions.external: For your security, this action requires you to confirm your identity.

recentAuth.codeHelp: The 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
recentAuth.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

popupBlocked.title: Pop-up blocked
popupBlocked.description: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.

popupClosed.title: Sign-in window closed
popupClosed.description: The window was closed before sign-in finished. Continue again when you're ready.

progress.waiting: Finish signing in with your provider in the window that opened.

external.unconfirmed: Your provider didn't confirm a fresh sign-in, so nothing was changed. Try again.

unavailable.title: Sign-in is unavailable
unavailable.description: No sign-in method is enabled on this instance. Contact your administrator.

passwordReset.title: Your password was reset
passwordReset.description: Sign in with your new password. You were signed out on every device.

twoFactorDisabled.title: Two-factor authentication is off
twoFactorDisabled.description: For your security, you were signed out on every device, including this one. Sign in again to continue.

challengeExpired.title: Your sign-in attempt expired
challengeExpired.description: Sign in again with your password to continue.

identityUnlinked.title: Sign-in method removed
identityUnlinked.description: For your security, you were signed out on every device, including this one. Sign in again to continue.

secondFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
secondFactor.description: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication. Enter a verification code to finish signing in.
secondFactor.codeHelp: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
secondFactor.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.backupHelp: Enter one of the backup codes you saved, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKLM-NPQR. Each code works once.
secondFactor.backupRequired: Enter one of your backup codes.
secondFactor.backupFormat: Backup codes have 16 letters and digits in four groups, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKLM-NPQR.
secondFactor.rememberHelp: Skip this step on this browser until the trust expires. Don't use this on a shared computer.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the e-mail address or username you sign in with. You'll receive a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentDescription: If an eligible account matches the information you entered, password reset instructions will be sent to its e-mail address.
forgot.sentNotice: The link in the e-mail can only be used once and expires after a while. If nothing arrives, check your spam folder or contact your administrator.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Enter a new password for your account. You'll use it the next time you sign in.
reset.consequence: Resetting your password signs you out on every device.

dead.used: This reset link was already used

forcedPassword.title: Set a new password
forcedPassword.description: Choose a new password to continue to your account.
forcedPassword.reasonTitle: You signed in with a temporary password
forcedPassword.reasonDescription: A temporary password was issued for this account. It only lets you set a new password, which you need to do before continuing.
forcedPassword.consequence: Your other sessions and trusted devices will be signed out.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.description: This instance requires two-factor authentication for accounts that sign in with a password. Set up an authenticator app to continue.

setup.scanDescription: Open an authenticator app on your phone and scan this code to add your account.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for adding this account to an authenticator app. If you can't scan it, use the setup key instead.
setup.manualKeyLabel: Can't scan the code? Enter this setup key in the app:
setup.verifyTitle: 2. Enter the code from the app
setup.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for this account.
setup.expiredDescription: For your security, setup keys are only valid for a few minutes. Start again to get a new key, and remove the old entry from your authenticator app.

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.description: If you lose access to your authenticator app, each code signs you in once. These codes won't be shown again.
backupCodes.copyFailed: The codes couldn't be copied. Download them or write them down instead.
backupCodes.downloadLabel: Download the backup codes as a text file
backupCodes.acknowledge: I saved these backup codes somewhere safe

file.heading: {{appName}} backup codes
file.note: Each code can be used once to sign in if you can't use your authenticator app.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in with your password.
twoFactor.offDescription: Your account is protected by your password only.
twoFactor.external: Your account signs in with an external provider, which manages its own two-factor authentication.
twoFactor.backupCodesLow: You're running low on backup codes. Generate new ones to stay prepared.

policy.title: Required by this instance
policy.description: An administrator requires two-factor authentication for accounts that sign in with a password.
policy.enabled: An administrator requires two-factor authentication for accounts that sign in with a password, so it can't be turned off.

regenerate.title: Generate new backup codes?
regenerate.description: Your current backup codes stop working immediately.

disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication?
disable.description: You'll be signed out on every device, including this one, and all trusted devices will be removed.

notice.regenerated: Your new backup codes are active. The previous codes no longer work.

trustedDevices.title: Trusted devices
trustedDevices.description: Browsers where you chose to skip the two-factor step. Removing one doesn't sign anyone out; the next sign-in there asks for a code again.

policy.enabled: A trusted device skips the two-factor step for {{duration}} after you choose to remember it.
policy.disabled: Remembering devices is turned off on this instance, so trusted devices don't skip two-factor verification.

empty.title: No trusted devices
empty.description: When you sign in with two-factor authentication, you can choose to remember the browser you're using.

revoke.label: Remove trusted device: {{device}}
revoke.title: Remove this trusted device?
revoke.description: The next sign-in from this browser will ask for a two-factor code. Nobody is signed out.

revokeCurrent.title: Stop trusting this browser?
revokeCurrent.description: You stay signed in, but the next sign-in from this browser will ask for a two-factor code.

revokeAll.title: Remove all trusted devices?
revokeAll.description: Every browser will ask for a two-factor code at its next sign-in. Nobody is signed out.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.description: You've been invited to {{appName}}. Complete your details to finish creating your account.
invite.emailBound: Your account uses the address this invite was sent to. The invite expires {{date}}.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your new e-mail address
verifyEmail.description: Confirming makes this address the one you sign in with. Everywhere this account is signed in will be signed out, and you will need to sign in again.
verifyEmail.reconcileFailed: We couldn't refresh your session state. Reload the page if something looks out of date.

malformed.title: This verification link is incomplete
malformed.description: The link is missing its verification code or was copied incorrectly. Open the link from the e-mail again.

success.title: E-mail address confirmed
success.description: Your new address is now the one you sign in with. Sign in again to continue.
success.signedIn: The new address is now active for this account. Your current session was not affected.

dead.taken: This address is no longer available

identityLinks.title: Connected accounts
identityLinks.description: External accounts you can use to sign in to Palmr.
identityLinks.neverUsed: Not used to sign in yet

empty.title: No connected accounts
empty.description: Connect an external account to sign in with it.

available.title: Connect an account
available.hint: You'll be asked to confirm it's you, then sent to the provider to approve the connection.

identityLinks.noProviders: No external sign-in providers are available on this instance.

unlink.label: Remove {{provider}}
unlink.title: Remove {{provider}}?
unlink.description: You will no longer be able to sign in to Palmr with this account.
unlink.consequence: For your security, you'll be signed out of Palmr on every device, including this one.

success.title: Identity confirmed
success.description: You can close this window and return to Palmr.

invalid.title: Nothing to confirm here
invalid.description: This page only finishes confirming your identity with your sign-in provider.
